content: VLA fine-tuning dataset pitfalls: (1) Bad episode boundaries and inconsistent action normalization are leading causes of fine-tune failures. (2) OpenVLA expects actions in [-1,1] — normalization stats must be computed from YOUR dataset, not LIBERO defaults. (3) Disabling either shuffling or normalization causes near-collapse in performance. (4) LIBERO stores MuJoCo states in HDF5 (not raw observations) — must run regeneration step. (5) OpenVLA fine-tuning needs RLDS format not raw HDF5. (6) LIBERO action space is 7D delta end-effector pose (Cartesian) + gripper — converting delta/absolute rotation representations fails if you simply subtract rotation values (not a valid operation for rotations). (7) Action playback trajectories drift over time in robosuite — must set states directly, not replay actions.
